V1_Baseline_12M_18S.title: Burn Mage V1 (Original Logged Deck — 12M/18S)
V1_Baseline_12M_18S.notes: Original 12M/18S list with 2x Smoldering Grove, 2x Story of the Waygate, Kalec, Antonidas, Arrival of the Titans.

V2_Baseline_13M_17S.title: Burn Mage V2 (2nd Logged Deck — 13M/17S)

V2_1_Baseline_11M_19S.title: Burn Mage V2.1 (Last Logged Deck — 11M/19S)
